name: Kavan Cardoza (Kavan the Kid)
bio: Director and AI filmmaker based in Los Angeles (originally from Boise, Idaho), co-founder of Phantom X.
bioMore: Started with viral AI fan films, then directed Echo Hunter — the first AI film with an approved SAG-AFTRA cast. Creator of The Chronicles of Bone, his ongoing monthly fantasy series for Freepik. Also directed Last Recall for Wonder Studios' Beyond The Loop. According to FilmFreeway, also a photographer and writer.
